retroGuide: Install mGBA from the RetroGameCorner, then approve individual Game Boy, Game Boy Color or Game Boy Advance games for the active child. A ROM is a local copy of a game. Supply ROMs and any BIOS files yourself and use only files you have permission to use. This setup uses mGBA without an external BIOS. Check the game’s content and controls first. Saves and save states are stored separately for each child and game.
